barRaise.topFinding: Full pass: v1.1.3 shipped since the last run and the tree went dirty again overnight, so the skip gate did not hold. That release was a good one, it cleared every stranded fix, made the runtime mirror byte-identical for the first time in the series, told the truth about the cache-bust contract at index.html:109-116, corrected the discord-notify header paths, and added the four domain lens tags. It also made a defect visible that a dirty mirror had been hiding: X:\YesAndEverything\apothecary\CHANGELOG.md is git-tracked, publicly served, and frozen at v0.5.0 (2026-05-18) beside a v1.1.3 pill, fourteen releases of drift. The cause is an absent mirror step rather than a broken one, deploy-to-yae.ps1:35-47 copies index.html and robocopies src/ data/ styles/ and that is the whole list, so a file hand-placed in the destination on 2026-05-18 can never be updated by any release. Nothing links to it, so no visitor is being shown v0.5.0, but it is a published file contradicting the app beside it and it drifts one release per release. Second, the stranded-doc-fix pattern returned within twenty-four hours of the release that cleared it: DEPLOY.md carries a correct uncommitted edit removing a Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .git step aimed at 866 MB of history the section 8 won't-fix decision preserves. Health holds at 83 with the composition moved, the app gained on reliability, runbook currency, and skill-chain handoff, and the published surface lost the same amount across four release-pipeline and voice lenses.

tensionsOpen.title: The audit chain writes correct fixes and is forbidden from releasing them, and no task owns the trigger. v1.1.3 drained the whole backlog on 2026-07-27 and it refilled with DEPLOY.md the same night, which is the cleanest evidence yet that this is structural. Resolution: keep the chain read-only on releases, but give the trigger an owner, either a docs-only-diff gated ship step at the end of the nightly audit or a weekly task. Past the adr-promoter threshold at five runs.

Mirroring only runtime files keeps the deploy fast and the published surface minimal, which is why CHANGELOG.md is not in the copy list. But the file is already tracked and published in YaE, so not-mirrored means there-and-permanently-stale. Resolution: pick one and encode it. Two lines to add it to the copy list, one commit to delete it from YaE. Leaving it is the only option that is not defensible.

Routing the three static-import modules through ctx matches the documented pattern but adds indirection to call sites that read plainly; stamping ?v= into static specifiers from release.ps1 keeps source clean but puts a source rewrite in the release path. Resolution: take the ctx route for saved-labels.js alone, leave autofit.js and print.js static with a note, add a graph check to the test suite.

Word-aware truncation fixes rendering everywhere but ratifies 43 records that violate a documented constraint; raising the cap to 320 honors the content only if the back card holds it at the smallest size, which nobody has measured; trimming honors the constraint but edits deliberate prose. Resolution: measure the 317-char record on the smallest template first, then pick, and make truncation word-aware regardless as a floor.

Stripping the vestigial icon field removes dead surface but migrate.js:181 backfills it so pre-v1.1 saved labels load. Resolution: stop writing icon and delete it from the 60 records, keep normalizeState tolerant of it on read.
